# Stack: `jl-stack`

Its children one under the other, with one space between them: the layout of a form.

- Class `JlStack`, a template: `import { JlStack } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/stack

A stack puts what it holds one under the other, each item as wide as the stack, with one space between
them. It is the layout of a form's fields, wherever they are: a dialog's body, a page, a card, a drawer. A dialog lays
out nothing itself, so its fields go in a stack rather than straight in the dialog.

Each child is an item, a bare text included: wrap a sentence that holds a link or a strong word in a <p>.

## Use

```ts
import { JlInput, JlStack } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlStack gap="md">
  <JlInput placeholder="First" />
  <JlInput placeholder="Second" />
  <JlInput placeholder="Third" />
</JlStack>
```

```html
<jl-stack gap="md">
  <jl-input placeholder="First"></jl-input>
  <jl-input placeholder="Second"></jl-input>
  <jl-input placeholder="Third"></jl-input>
</jl-stack>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `gap` (attribute `gap`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The space between the items: 8, 16 or 24 pixels.

## Slots

- The default slot: The items, one under the other.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The grid that lays out the items.
- `--gap` (custom property): The space between the items, which overrides gap.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A form

The fields of a form, each in its jl-field.

```html
<jl-stack class="narrow">
  <jl-field label="Name" required>
    <jl-input placeholder="Warehouse North"></jl-input>
  </jl-field>
  <jl-field label="Category">
    <jl-select options='[{"value":"store","label":"Store"},{"value":"depot","label":"Depot"}]'></jl-select>
  </jl-field>
  <jl-field label="Notes" hint="Seen by the whole team.">
    <jl-textarea rows="3"></jl-textarea>
  </jl-field>
</jl-stack>
```

### In a dialog

The fields of a dialog: the stack spaces them, the dialog only frames them.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-form" variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New category"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-dialog class="form" heading="New category">
  <jl-stack>
    <jl-field label="Name" required>
      <jl-input placeholder="Spare parts"></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
    <jl-field label="Code" hint="Three letters, on the labels.">
      <jl-input placeholder="SPA"></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
  </jl-stack>
  <jl-button slot="actions" label="Cancel"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="Create"></jl-button>
</jl-dialog>
```

```js
const dialog = root.querySelector('jl-dialog.form');
root.querySelector('.open-form').events.register('press', () => dialog.show());
for (const button of dialog.querySelectorAll('jl-button')) {
  button.events.register('press', () => dialog.close());
}
```

### Gaps

Small between the lines of a group, large between groups.

```html
<jl-stack gap="lg" class="narrow">
  <jl-stack gap="sm">
    <jl-checkbox label="Email me when a job ends" checked></jl-checkbox>
    <jl-checkbox label="Email me when a job fails" checked></jl-checkbox>
  </jl-stack>
  <jl-stack gap="sm">
    <jl-switch label="Compact rows"></jl-switch>
    <jl-switch label="Show the IDs"></jl-switch>
  </jl-stack>
</jl-stack>
```
